s00-02-story-837dba.wav.text: Frogs fill the palace. Hail falls with fire inside it.

s00-03-story-0e54ae.wav.text: And then comes a darkness you can feel.

s00-04-talk-91f7ab.wav.text: Most people remember the ten plagues as a list of disasters.

s00-05-story-a29952.wav.text: An angry God, hitting Egypt again and again.

s00-06-pivot-2ebbd4.wav.text: But read it closely, and it's something else.

s07-02-story-ee0910.wav.text: At midnight, death would pass through the land, to every firstborn son.

s07-03-story-42ed64.wav.text: But God gave Israel a way through.

s07-04-story-faa980.wav.text: Each family killed a lamb, and painted its blood on the doorframe.

s07-05-grave-7f79f8.wav.text: And when I see the blood, I will pass over you

s07-06-story-7e15bb.wav.text: That night, a great cry went up across Egypt.

s07-07-story-ffab4c.wav.text: But behind the doors marked with blood, every child was safe.

s07-08-story-809e89.wav.text: By morning, Pharaoh was begging them to leave.

s01-01-story-bd4ffd.wav.text: For generations, Israel had been slaves in Egypt.

s01-02-story-8e39d1.wav.text: Then God sent Moses to Pharaoh, the most powerful king on earth, with one message: let my people go.

s01-04-grave-63a4f1.wav.text: But Pharaoh said, ‘Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice and let Israel go?’

s01-05-pivot-2800a8.wav.text: That question is the whole story.

s01-06-talk-5e01aa.wav.text: Ten times, God is going to answer it.

s02-01-story-ad9a3c.wav.text: First, the Nile. It was Egypt's lifeline.

s02-02-story-eb3914.wav.text: They worshipped it, because it fed the whole country.

s02-03-grave-53f568.wav.text: and all the water in the Nile turned into blood.

s02-04-story-89ddc5.wav.text: The fish died. The river stank.

s02-05-story-772797.wav.text: And the god of the Nile could do nothing.

s02-06-talk-9a7f0f.wav.text: Pharaoh's magicians copied the trick, so Pharaoh shrugged it off.

s02-07-story-57d8ed.wav.text: His heart was hard, and he would not listen.

s03-02-story-e54b66.wav.text: In the ovens, in the beds, in the king's own bedroom.

s03-03-story-aad073.wav.text: Egypt had a goddess with the head of a frog.

s03-05-story-2b59e0.wav.text: Then gnats, from the dust of the ground.

s03-06-story-2edcf8.wav.text: This time the magicians failed, and they told Pharaoh so.

s03-07-grave-6e841f.wav.text: This is the finger of God.

s03-09-pivot-3ed158.wav.text: But not in Goshen, where Israel lived.

s04-02-story-143fe3.wav.text: God draws a line between his people and Egypt.

s04-03-story-1f0696.wav.text: Egypt's livestock die in the fields. Israel's are spared.

s04-04-story-13eb21.wav.text: Then boils break out on people and animals alike.

s04-05-story-da77a8.wav.text: The magicians can't even stand in front of Moses.

s04-06-talk-0eff8b.wav.text: And still, Pharaoh's heart is hard.

s05-01-grave-1c7116.wav.text: Then hail, with fire flashing through it.

s05-02-story-1b7322.wav.text: The worst storm Egypt had ever seen.

s05-03-story-15a1fb.wav.text: Locusts eat whatever the hail left.

s05-06-grave-d544ac.wav.text: and there was pitch darkness in all the land of Egypt three days.

s05-07-grave-ccdf16.wav.text: … but all the people of Israel had light where they lived.

s05-08-talk-4ac570.wav.text: Egypt's greatest god was the sun.

s05-09-story-9d20db.wav.text: For three days, it was simply gone.

s06-02-story-eafc23.wav.text: Why not one plague, and done?

s06-04-grave-205745.wav.text: and on all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am the LORD.

s06-05-talk-7da3a2.wav.text: Every plague was aimed at something Egypt trusted.

s06-06-story-780879.wav.text: The river. The land. The cattle. The sky. The sun.

s06-07-talk-895f9d.wav.text: One by one, each was shown to be powerless.
